About A2B Labs

Plain English Interaction and Modernization

See how our simple review process works, the controls that keep your team in charge, ready-to-try examples, and how your files stay private.

01 · Add Your Files on Home

Drop in older files, pick a ready-to-try sample, or type in everyday English what rule you want checked.

02 · Compare Old vs. Updated Code

View your original file side by side with the cleaned-up version in Workspace, with every changed section highlighted for you.

03 · Read Plain-English Change Notes

Every update comes with a simple note explaining what that part does and why it changed. Edit or turn off any note before approving.

04 · Review Summary & Export (.zip)

See a plain-English summary of everything that improved, check estimated time and money saved, and download your approved files in one .zip folder.

Finds Hidden Rule Mistakes

Spots rule errors buried inside older files — like conditions that were accidentally skipped, nested in the wrong order, or rounded inaccurately.

Your Team Stays in Control

Nothing goes out automatically. Reviewers can edit any plain-English note or turn off a change and rebuild the update before approving.

Point-and-Match Highlighting

Point at any plain-English note to light up the exact lines before and after the fix — no programming knowledge needed to follow along.

Clear Summary & One-Click .zip

Creates an easy-to-share overview showing what each file did before, what it does now, and how much time and budget your team saves.

fee_waiver.cbl · Monthly Fee Waiver

Fixes a rule error that wrongly charged students under 25 a $12 monthly checking fee when they didn't have direct deposits.

overdraft_fee.cbl · Overdraft Protection

Applies the $50 cushion rule and checks combined checking and savings balances before charging a $35 overdraft fee.

wire_limit_check.cbl · Wire Approval Limits

Makes sure international wires over $10,000 always require two-person sign-off instead of being approved automatically.

loan_interest_calc.cbl · Loan Grace Period

Restores the 15-day late payment grace period and keeps the 4.0% minimum interest rate floor intact.

Stays on Your Device

Your queued files, edit notes, and savings calculator settings stay in temporary browser storage on your machine while you work.

Not Stored for Model Training

Uploaded snippets and sample runs are processed only for your active session and are never saved to train external models.

Safe Offline Preview

Reviews and sample checks run safely in an isolated workspace — never connecting to live accounts or external databases.
